$comment: A/B for the VDE-AR-N 4105 §5.7.2 settling lag on the Q(U) droop (qv_droop_settling_tau_s).

Motivation: in eval_full_v2_20260727-043406 the LV-S voltage trajectory limit-cycles bang-bang for the whole run. Measured on task 7216: plant |dV/dQ| = 0.093 pu/MVar, aggregate droop slope Sq_max/0.02 = 45.7 MVar/pu => loop gain 4.25. Q(U) is proportional-only with no settling time, so the discrete map e_{n+1} = -4.25*e_n diverges and clips on the deadband. LV-S is 1-LV-rural1: 0.91 MVar of inverter capability circle (VVW gives each unit its FULL circle) behind a 160 kVA substation.

Arms: tau=3.0 is the new default (effective gain 0.71 at the 0.5 s poll, settles in ~9 s); tau=0 reproduces the legacy instantaneous droop; the VVW-off and droop-off arms are the reference points from the eval campaign.
Judge on: sustained oscillation (tail-half avg_vm_pu peak-to-peak and direction flips in timeseries.csv), events__qv_droop, duration_s, and that PWSF / voltage violations / claims do not regress.
name: ab_qv_droop_settling
